summary_zh: 题目、例子和参考解法都没问题（建树、最近邻、k 近邻、矩形计数与逐点暴力算法完全一致）。只有追问里“近似最近邻”的公式把 (1+ε)² 乘错了边：照原式做反而会访问更多节点、根本不会近似。已改成正确的写法，并加了一条验证。

issues.where: 参考解答 追问（近似最近邻）
issues.problem_zh: 原文说把剪枝判断放宽为 (q_a−s)² ≤ (1+ε)²·d_best² 可以换来更激进的剪枝。实际上这个条件比精确搜索的条件更容易满足，另一侧会被访问得更多：实测 4000 个 8 维均匀点、ε=1 时平均访问 3282 个节点，而精确搜索只访问 573 个，并且永远不会漏掉最近点——和这段话要讲的效果正好相反。
issues.change_zh: 改为把“访问另一侧”的条件收紧为 (1+ε)²·(q_a−s)² ≤ d_best²。同样的数据下平均只访问 93 个节点，返回的点到查询点的距离不超过真实最近距离的 1+ε 倍。

issues.problem_zh: 原来没有检查近似最近邻这条追问。
issues.change_zh: 新增一段检查：按改正后的条件搜索，结果距离不超过真实最近距离的 1.5 倍（ε=0.5），且访问的节点总数少于精确搜索；把条件换回原来的写法，这条检查会失败。

checked: ran page (both languages) before and after the edit

rebuilt the tree from the statement's rule with an independent recursive builder and compared the exact structure and height bound on 6000 random inputs (uniform, integer grid, duplicate rows, all-identical points, constant columns, points on one line; d in 1..6, n in 1..60)

compared nearest / knn against an exact-arithmetic (Fraction) linear scan with the (distance, index) tie rule, and count_in_box against a per-point scan, on 36000 queries including queries at stored points, far queries, degenerate and inverted boxes, boxes with edges on point coordinates, infinite boxes: 0 mismatches
checked all ValueError cases the statement lists
verified the worked examples (tree shape, distances, trace with 4 visited nodes, knn, box count)

counted visited nodes: nearest in 2-D grows like log n (13.7 at n=500 to 21.1 at n=32000); knn about 2k + O(log n); all-identical points visit all n nodes; fraction of tree visited vs d at n=4000 is 49% at d=10, 85% at d=12, 98.5% at d=16 (supports the 'd around 10-20' claim)

counted nodes visited by count_in_box: visited / n^(1-1/d) stays constant (about 5.5 in 2-D, 2.2 in 3-D) for n from 1000 to 64000; degenerate inputs (all-identical points, 8x8 integer grid) stay sublinear too
tested the approximate-NN follow-up with both the page's formula and the corrected one, counting visited nodes and the distance ratio
new check fails with the original formula (run on a scratch copy) and passes with the corrected one
re-derived the height bound, the far-side lower bound, the ring-search stopping rule and the n^(1-1/d) crossing argument
